mechanism: Furosemide-induced volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities may increase minocycline nephrotoxicity and photosensitivity risk; minocycline may rarely cause drug-induced lupus which could be exacerbated by diuretic use.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and fluid status closely; counsel patient on sun protection; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment develops.
